decisions.reason: As a training service that builds directly on the installed base and strengthens customer relationships, it is likely to meet aspiration levels or at least be easy to carry with available organisational slack.
This accessory fits the firm's established machining offer and can leverage existing customers and service channels, so management would usually retain it unless sales clearly disappointed.

Because it is distant from the firm's established offer, its performance is more uncertain and more likely to fall short of aspirations, prompting problemistic search and resource reallocation in a medium-sized firm.
A high-speed CNC milling machine is very close to the firm's core business and a multi-model line signals strategic commitment, making satisfactory performance and continued support more likely.

The automatic tool change system complements the firm's machinery portfolio and customer productivity promise, so it is likely to be viewed as a worthwhile extension rather than a candidate for withdrawal.
